flagship.note: Do not use the nickname VROO Model S

grille.shape: wide low hexagonal aperture, gently flattened top edge
grille.mesh: fine dark honeycomb, dense and even
grille.frame: thin continuous perimeter; grade may tint frame black / satin / heritage-gold but must not change outline
grille.grade_rule: Basic–Performance keep frame dark or satin; Heritage may use restrained gold perimeter only

emblem.form: compact shield with winged V mark
emblem.grade_rule: same silhouette all grades; material only may change (black / silver / heritage-gold)

headlamp.housing: slim horizontal projector module, sharp outer corner, soft inner fade into fender
headlamp.grade_rule: housing silhouette locked for all grades; lens clarity and gold accent optional by grade

drl.graphic: two parallel cool-white LED blades; upper blade slightly longer; slight inward taper toward grille
drl.accent: optional thin heritage-gold eyelash under lower blade on Heritage only
drl.grade_rule: twin-blade graphic mandatory all grades; gold eyelash Heritage-only, never thicken DRL bars

immutable_dna.front_signature: wide hex mesh + winged-V shield + twin-blade DRL
immutable_dna.wheel_signature: large multi-spoke wheel; finish may vary by grade

gold_trim_language.principle: restrained premium — thin lines, never thick sport armor

bumper_language.form: smooth continuous lower fascia, modest side intakes, no deep race splitter
bumper_language.grade_rule: Performance may deepen intakes slightly; Heritage keeps executive calm with thin gold lip only

upgrade_rule: grades may add parts and performance cues but must never replace the family silhouette, grille outline, emblem form, or twin-blade DRL graphic
